cases.note: The first thing the out-of-band workspace does is a plain mkdir, which meets the mount root before anything has created it. A OneDrive mount's root is its key_prefix folder, which a file upload creates as a side effect but a folder create does not, so mkdir under a root nothing has written to yet has to create the prefix chain first. The listing_ttl cases start with mkdir -p on a fresh account, so they cover the -p form.
